title: Index Constituent Module (F-020)
description: Create synapse/core/market/constituent.py with IndexCode enum (CSI300/CSI500/CSI1000/SSE50), ConstituentSnapshot and ConstituentChange frozen dataclasses. Implement point-in-time snapshot loading, change detection, and membership checks. Parquet/CSV snapshot files in data/market/index/{code}/.
convergence: IndexCode enum: CSI300 (000300.SH), CSI500 (000905.SH), CSI1000 (000852.SH), SSE50 (000016.SH), CUSTOM
ConstituentSnapshot frozen dataclass: index_code, date, members (frozenset), weights (dict or None)
ConstituentChange frozen dataclass: date, ticker, action (add/remove), index_code, reason
load_constituents resolves to latest snapshot <= target date
load_constituent_changes returns changes sorted by date
is_member works correctly for all supported indices
Missing index directory raises FileNotFoundError with path suggestion
Empty members file returns snapshot with empty frozenset
Future date request uses latest available, logs info
New unit tests: load, membership, changes, empty members, future date, missing directory
